# CONTUS Tech

> > CONTUS Tech is a digital transformation and product engineering company specializing in IoT, AI/ML, cloud solutions, and custom software development with expertise in Flutter, Node.js, Angular, and AWS technologies.

Based in Chennai, India with presence in Santa Clara, California, CONTUS Tech delivers end-to-end digital solutions including OTT platforms, IoT development, MVP services, and remote developer teams. Founded by Sriram Manoharan, the company has created products like MirrorFly and VPlayed while serving enterprises across manufacturing, healthcare, retail, and telecommunications sectors.

## Key Topics

- Digital Transformation
- IoT Solutions & Development
- AI/ML Automation
- Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
- Product Engineering
- MVP Development
- Cross-Platform Apps (Flutter)
- Node.js & Angular Development
- OTT Video Streaming
- Agile Methodology
- UI/UX Design
- Cloud Migration & Managed Services
- Remote Developer Teams
- CPaaS Solutions
- Microservices Architecture
